interface: One-Wire, parasite or 3.3 V powered, daisy-chainable

measurands.name: temperature_c
measurands.accuracy: ±0.5 degC from -10 to +85 degC, wider outside

failure_modes: reads +85.0 exactly: power-on reset default, bus fault, not a real reading
reads -127 or CRC errors: wiring or bus contention
slow drift against a reference: sensor aged or self-heating in enclosure
mounting: shaded, ventilated, away from direct sun and heat sources; not rain-exposed in this packaging
